resources.string: Join a game with your blaster
Players: tap one for their settings
Turn on your blaster, then connect it.

A SimpleCoil QR code holds a blaster's Bluetooth address, and optionally a player name. Scanning it with Connect Blaster Using QR connects straight to that blaster instead of searching for the nearest one, and sets your player name.

This helps most when lots of players are pairing at the same time: a normal connect may pick up someone else's blaster, while a QR code always finds the right one.

To make one, connect to the blaster once, then tap Generate QR on the game screen before a game starts. Enter a player name (or leave it blank), save the image, then print it and tape it to the side of the blaster. The code prints about 1 inch (25 mm) wide.

See docs/QR_CODES.md in the SimpleCoil source for the code format.

SimpleCoil needs these permissions to find and connect to your blaster: Bluetooth, location (for Bluetooth scanning and the game map) and notifications (to keep the blaster connected while the app is in the background).
SimpleCoil uses the camera to scan your blaster\'s QR code.

A safe zone shrinks in phases. Outside it you lose health. Once respawns are over, an elimination puts you out; the last team standing wins. Needs a field border.
Score is the distance of each elimination instead of the count. Needs GPS on every phone.

Each team\'s flag sits at its base (its first spawn, or one end of the field). Walk into the enemy base to take theirs, and back to yours to score. A carrier who is eliminated drops it. Needs a field border.
Stand on loot to pick it up. It only counts once you stand in an extraction zone after it opens; if you are eliminated you drop it all. Needs a field border.

Two teams, rounds with no respawns. One attacker carries the bomb: plant it at a site, or the defenders stop you. Everyone comes back for the next round, and the teams swap at half time. Needs a field border.
A few players start infected. Anyone they eliminate is infected too. Survivors win by lasting the round. Play it as free for all.
